question: Contá los ensayos de cáncer de próstata que prueban algún fármaco aprobado que actúa sobre el gen AR (receptor de andrógenos).

attempts.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT td.nct_id)
FROM linking.trial_drug td
JOIN linking.drug d ON d.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id AND d.approved
JOIN linking.drug_target dt ON dt.parent_chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
JOIN linking.target_gene tg ON tg.target_chembl_id = dt.target_chembl_id AND tg.gene_symbol = 'AR'
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM linking.trial_condition tc
  JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
  JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id AND md.label = 'Prostatic Neoplasms'
  WHERE tc.nct_id = td.nct_id)
